title: Lab - OS upgrades
description: Take a node out of service and bring it back.
scenario: Take a node out of service and bring it back. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Drain
tasks.instructions: Drain node01 so it can be rebooted. What flags are needed and why?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Uncordon
tasks.instructions: Bring node01 back and confirm new Pods may land there.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Stuck drain
tasks.instructions: A Pod on node01 is not managed by a controller. Drain the node anyway, consciously.
tasks.verification: kubectl get pods -A -o wide | grep node01
